Grip giving out before your back's actually tired is a progression gap, not a program problem. A few things that help: dead-hangs and farmer's carries to build raw grip endurance, chalk if your gym allows it, and alternating your grip (mixed or switching over/underhand) across sets so the same tendons aren't maxed every time. Also check your hook — thumb-over-bar full grip tends to fail later than an open hook.

If you're already crushing your forearms with other pulling work that session, the fatigue could just be carrying over — worth looking at where pull-ups sit in your split.
